office: the National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA), at its registration centres

routes.label: in person at a NIRA registration centre

note: The European Union Agency for Asylum's report on Mogadishu, quoting the World Bank's NIRA support team: NIRA, set up by the Identification and Registration Act (Law 9 of March 2023), is open to everyone; as of 1 April 2026 registration and issuance of the physical card were free of cost. The Government's older service page gives USD 5 (not modelled). The age it's issued from, its term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: European Union Agency for Asylum, Somalia: Displacement in Mogadishu, 4.1 Application process and identity verification
sources.said: Established under the Identification and Registration Act, Law No. 009 of March 2023, the National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) is Somalia’s institution responsible for managing the country's comprehensive national identification system. ... As of 1 April 2026, ‘registration and issuance of ID physical card [was] free of cost’.

sources.title: Federal Government of Somalia, National ID card (service page)
sources.said: US$ 5, payable through mobile money transfer to a bank account displayed in the centre.
